summary: Build account plans, renewal playbooks, and health scorecards in advanced customer success training. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Customer success management gives account teams a structured way to guide adoption, track customer health, and manage renewal risk. This training is for professionals handling customer accounts, onboarding, or retention, and covers mapping customer journeys, building health scorecards, and creating strategic account plans. Learners also practice renewal-risk reporting and executive business reviews to communicate customer status and progress.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage customer accounts, renewal risk, adoption outcomes, and cross-functional customer workflows. It fits intermediate-level practitioners who already work with customer data or commercial relationships and need a more disciplined customer success management approach.
modules: Customer Health Scoring and Journey Analysis
Strategic Account Planning and Renewal Design
Customer Success Strategy and Action Planning
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and a working ability to review account data, customer journey notes, or CRM exports. Prior exposure to customer-facing operations, renewals, or account management will help you apply the exercises quickly, but no programming or advanced analytics background is needed.
